classification: secondary archival reconstruction of a repeated Cicada 1033/3301 operator chain; source paths are pinned to one archive commit

stages.operation: emit primes in increasing order through 3301; pause 2 seconds rather than 0.5 seconds on 1033 and 3301
stages.consequence: the pair is explicitly highlighted inside an ordered prime stream, making their prime ordinals player-recoverable

stages.operation: for prime n, test decimal reversal; return + when both n and reverse(n) are prime
stages.consequence: 1033 and 3301 form exactly the emirp relation explicitly taught by the service; get 1033 and get 3301 are also aliases for the same message

stages.operation: Cicada requests BASE29 1033, then later DH 3301; one published test repeats DH 3301 three times
use concatenated ordered pair 33011033 as the OpenPuff password that extracts magicsquares.txt

interpretationBoundary: The archive shows deliberate repeated use of the pair and directly motivates decimal reversal and prime-order context. Counting prime ordinals remains a solver inference, though the boot image exposes the ordered prime stream. Division by 29 or 58 is a later LP-specific normalization and is not asserted by the historical sources.
